name: Jamaica
headline: Jamaica: +0.1% growth in 2025, 3.9% inflation, debt 66% of GDP
sections: Jamaica is a $22.6 billion economy (2025), the world's 130th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +0.1% in 2025, slower than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $13K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 7.7% of GDP (2025).

Consumer prices rose 3.9% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 10.3% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 3.4% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 10.8% (2025).
Gross government debt is 66% of GDP (2025), a elevated level that has fallen from 101% in 2020. The general government balance is −2.5% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is +1.5% of GDP (2025). Net FDI inflows were 1.2% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 60% of GDP by 2031, on a declining path from today's level. Life expectancy is 71.6 years (2024). Population: 2.8 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
